preconditions: porosity values and their measurement basis are declared
burial depth and vertical datum are declared
depositional and current states are not silently mixed
coefficients are calibrated to compatible material and burial conditions
decisionLogic: Use solid-volume conservation for one-dimensional compacted/decompacted thickness
Stack transformed non-negative thickness fields to preserve shared contacts
Treat spatially variable porosity as differential compaction, not independent contact noise
Require direct evidence before adding cementation, dissolution, or disequilibrium compaction
limitations: Athy equilibrium form does not represent geological time, temperature, permeability evolution, pore-pressure feedback, or cement kinetics
mechanical compaction and chemical diagenesis remain separate evidence classes
no universal lithology-specific coefficient is supplied
validationMethod: equation identity, inverse transform, topology, negative and insufficient-evidence tests
reopenCondition: A history-dependent compaction model or normalized multi-region coefficient corpus is required
